bullets.text: The Greater Chennai Corporation reviewed monsoon drainage works and canal widening in Adyar and Sholinganallur, and the office should monitor flood readiness.
Karambakkam residents questioned the GCC and revenue department over a new PDS shop built on a pond, and the office should watch for an official clarification.
A Pallikaranai woman who went into a coma following an accident was awarded Rs 1.70 crore in compensation by court, and the office should note the judgment.
Interstate omnibuses blocked the Gummidipoondi border checkpost lanes in a protest, causing disruption, and the office should monitor transport department actions.
Collector Kavitha announced the operation of 134 government buses under the Chief Minister's Vetri Payanam scheme, and the office should review transport expansion in Thiruvallur.
Collector Kavitha announced that the public can lodge complaints regarding ration quantity discrepancies, and the office should track public grievances.
The PanIIT AP Summit 2026 in Vijayawada will spotlight AI, DeepTech, and innovation, and the office should track technological outcomes for digital services.
Soumya Anbumani stated that pressure will be exerted to gradually reduce liquor shops, and the office should monitor political developments regarding prohibition.
GK Vasan stated that TVK has high winning prospects in assembly bypolls, and the office should watch electoral trends.
Prime Minister Modi will visit Chennai on the 11th to inaugurate the Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro rail service, and the office should coordinate infrastructure event preparations.

stories.title: Okkiyam Maduvu Canal Widening Improves Chennai Flood Readiness
takeaways: The Greater Chennai Corporation reviewed monsoon flood preparedness works along the Okkiyam Maduvu Canal in Adyar.
Officials inspected canal widening and drainage infrastructure to prevent seasonal flooding in south Chennai zones.
stories.snippet: The Greater Chennai Corporation has reviewed stormwater drainage and canal works in Adyar and Sholinganallur zones, including the widening of the Okkiyam Maduvu Canal, as the city prepares for the Northeast monsoon.…

takeaways: Karambakkam residents questioned the revenue department regarding a PDS shop built on a pond site.
